descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S06 Imperfect photos still give a usable result (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A less-than-perfect photo (an imperfect or angled photo, not only a clean screenshot) still produces a usable result. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 6; TFA-92580 How it works 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given One photo per quality class, each with a ground-truth list

When Each photo is read by ai/vision:scanCensusSheet in its mode and goes through the client's own row clean-up

Then Every row a person can read comes back with the right name and room/unit. Every other field the truth has (MRN, age, DOB, diagnosis) comes back exactly or blank, never as a different value. No row is invented and no field the photo lacks is filled

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per photo: all truth rows present with the correct name + room/unit; every other truth field exact or blank (a wrong MRN, DOB or age, e.g. 300204 read as 300284, makes the photo fail); no extra rows; no field filled that the truth leaves blank. Threshold is Q3 (proposed 9/10 photos); every failing photo quoted with its returned rows

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (dev measures the deployed config); Source: dev.
